# # Verify protobuf well-known type contract compliance across protobuf compiler, gRPC runtime, and googleapis

Your team maintains a gRPC-based microservice architecture that depends on
protobuf well-known types (Timestamp, Duration, FieldMask, Struct, Any). After
upgrading protobuf to v25.1 and gRPC to v1.60.0, some services report
serialization errors when exchanging messages containing well-known types.

The issue may stem from contract drift between how protobuf defines well-known
types, how the gRPC C++ core runtime handles their serialization, and how
googleapis common protos depend on specific well-known type behaviors.

Your task:

1. Find where protobuf defines the well-known types — locate the .proto files
   and the language-specific runtime implementations (particularly the JSON
   serialization for Timestamp, Duration, and Struct). Identify any v25.x
   changes to serialization behavior.
2. Find where the gRPC C++ core handles protobuf serialization — locate the
   protobuf serialization integration, message codec, and any well-known type
   special-casing in the gRPC runtime.
3. Find where googleapis common protos reference well-known types — locate
   the .proto files that import google/protobuf/\*.proto and identify any
   assumptions about serialization format or field presence.
4. Map the contract chain: protobuf definitions -> gRPC runtime serialization
   -> googleapis consumer expectations.

Write your analysis to /workspace/analysis/IMPACT_REPORT.md with:

- Well-known type definition locations (protobuf repo)
- gRPC serialization integration points
- googleapis dependencies on well-known type behavior
- Contract violations or drift points


Search only these repositories: github.com/sg-evals/protobuf--v25.1, github.com/sg-evals/grpc--v1.60.0, github.com/sg-evals/googleapis--common-protos-1_3_1

The report has been written. Here is the full analysis:

---

## Impact Report: protobuf v25.1 / gRPC v1.60.0 / googleapis 1.3.1 WKT Contract Chain

---

### 1. Well-Known Type Definitions (protobuf v25.1)

**Proto schema files** — all in [`src/google/protobuf/`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/github.com/sg-evals/protobuf--v25.1/-/tree/src/google/protobuf):

| WKT | Proto file | JSON wire contract |
|---|---|---|
| Timestamp | [`timestamp.proto`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/github.com/sg-evals/protobuf--v25.1/-/blob/src/google/protobuf/timestamp.proto?L133-L144) | RFC 3339 string with `Z` suffix |
| Duration | [`duration.proto`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/github.com/sg-evals/protobuf--v25.1/-/blob/src/google/protobuf/duration.proto?L102-L115) | Decimal-seconds string with `"s"` suffix |
| Struct/Value/ListValue | [`struct.proto`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/github.com/sg-evals/protobuf--v25.1/-/blob/src/google/protobuf/struct.proto) | JSON object / value / array |
| Any | [`any.proto`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/github.com/sg-evals/protobuf--v25.1/-/blob/src/google/protobuf/any.proto?L100-L127) | `{"@type":"url", ...fields}` or `{"@type":"url","value":<wkt>}` |
| FieldMask | [`field_mask.proto`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/github.com/sg-evals/protobuf--v25.1/-/blob/src/google/protobuf/field_mask.proto?L180-L208) | Comma-separated camelCase paths |

**JSON serialization engine** (v25.x complete rewrite):
- Entry point: [`json/json.h`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/github.com/sg-evals/protobuf--v25.1/-/blob/src/google/protobuf/json/json.h)
- WKT classifier: [`descriptor_traits.h:ClassifyMessage()`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/github.com/sg-evals/protobuf--v25.1/-/blob/src/google/protobuf/json/internal/descriptor_traits.h?L58-L120) — dispatches on full type name under `google.protobuf.`
- Per-type writers in [`unparser.cc`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/github.com/sg-evals/protobuf--v25.1/-/blob/src/google/protobuf/json/internal/unparser.cc):

| WKT | Writer function | Lines |
|---|---|---|
| Timestamp | `WriteTimestamp` | [L579–640](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/github.com/sg-evals/protobuf--v25.1/-/blob/src/google/protobuf/json/internal/unparser.cc?L579-L640) |
| Duration | `WriteDuration` | [L642–687](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/github.com/sg-evals/protobuf--v25.1/-/blob/src/google/protobuf/json/internal/unparser.cc?L642-L687) |
| FieldMask | `WriteFieldMask` | [L689–726](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/github.com/sg-evals/protobuf--v25.1/-/blob/src/google/protobuf/json/internal/unparser.cc?L689-L726) |
| Struct/Value | `WriteStructValue`/`WriteValue` | [L495–576](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/github.com/sg-evals/protobuf--v25.1/-/blob/src/google/protobuf/json/internal/unparser.cc?L495-L576) |
| Any | `WriteAny` | [L728–790](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/github.com/sg-evals/protobuf--v25.1/-/blob/src/google/protobuf/json/internal/unparser.cc?L728-L790) |

Dispatch table: [`WriteMessage` L793–830](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/github.com/sg-evals/protobuf--v25.1/-/blob/src/google/protobuf/json/internal/unparser.cc?L793-L830).

**v25.x serialization behavior changes:**
1. **FieldMask strictness** — `WriteFieldMask` now rejects path characters outside `[a-z0-9._]` unless `allow_legacy_syntax` is set ([L712–713](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/github.com/sg-evals/protobuf--v25.1/-/blob/src/google/protobuf/json/internal/unparser.cc?L712-L713)).
2. **Empty `Value` silently discarded** — empty `google.protobuf.Value` entries in maps and repeated fields are dropped without error ([L259–262](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/github.com/sg-evals/protobuf--v25.1/-/blob/src/google/protobuf/json/internal/unparser.cc?L259-L262), [L367–371](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/github.com/sg-evals/protobuf--v25.1/-/blob/src/google/protobuf/json/internal/unparser.cc?L367-L371)).
3. **Value NaN/Infinity hard error** — now returns `InvalidArgumentError` ([L510–522](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/github.com/sg-evals/protobuf--v25.1/-/blob/src/google/protobuf/json/internal/unparser.cc?L510-L522)).
4. **Any empty value error** — `type_url` with no `value` bytes returns `"broken Any: missing value"` ([L741–743](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/github.com/sg-evals/protobuf--v25.1/-/blob/src/google/protobuf/json/internal/unparser.cc?L741-L743)).
5. **Duration sign-consistency enforced** — mixed-sign `seconds`/`nanos` now returns hard error ([L667–669](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/github.com/sg-evals/protobuf--v25.1/-/blob/src/google/protobuf/json/internal/unparser.cc?L667-L669)).
6. **New `unquote_int64_if_possible` option** in [`PrintOptions`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/github.com/sg-evals/protobuf--v25.1/-/blob/src/google/protobuf/json/json.h?L38-L55) — can remove quotes from int64 fields including `Timestamp.seconds`.

---

### 2. gRPC C++ Core Serialization Integration (v1.60.0)

**Binary codec (no WKT special-casing):** [`include/grpcpp/impl/proto_utils.h`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/github.com/sg-evals/grpc--v1.60.0/-/blob/include/grpcpp/impl/proto_utils.h) — `GenericSerialize`/`GenericDeserialize` use `ProtoBufferWriter`/`ProtoBufferReader` to write/read raw protobuf binary. WKTs are encoded as ordinary scalar fields; this path is **not** affected by JSON engine changes.

**xDS UPB layer (DRIFT RISK):** The gRPC core vendors frozen UPB-generated WKT headers:
- [`src/core/ext/upb-gen/google/protobuf/timestamp.upb.h`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/github.com/sg-evals/grpc--v1.60.0/-/blob/src/core/ext/upb-gen/google/protobuf/timestamp.upb.h)
- [`src/core/ext/upb-gen/google/protobuf/struct.upb.h`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/github.com/sg-evals/grpc--v1.60.0/-/blob/src/core/ext/upb-gen/google/protobuf/struct.upb.h)
- `any.upb.h`, `duration.upb.h`, `wrappers.upb.h`

These are static snapshots from gRPC v1.60.0 release time. [`src/core/ext/xds/xds_api.cc`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/github.com/sg-evals/grpc--v1.60.0/-/blob/src/core/ext/xds/xds_api.cc?L37-L41) imports all five and uses them directly to build xDS node metadata. If protobuf v25.1 ships an updated UPB runtime ABI, the frozen mini-table layouts become inconsistent, causing silent data corruption or crashes.

**JSON transcoding:** gRPC exposes `grpc::protobuf::json::JsonStringToMessage` (a thin wrapper over protobuf's JSON API). All v25.x JSON behavioral changes propagate through gRPC HTTP-JSON transcoding.

---

### 3. googleapis Common Proto WKT Dependencies (1.3.1)

All protos consume WKTs by import reference only. Critical patterns:

| googleapis proto | WKTs used | Risk surface |
|---|---|---|
| `google/longrunning/operations.proto` | `Any` (metadata, response) | Any with type_url but no bytes → v25.x error |
| `google/api/servicecontrol/v1/log_entry.proto` | `Timestamp`, `Any`, `Struct` | Null Struct values silently dropped |
| `google/rpc/error_details.proto` | `Duration` (RetryInfo.retry_delay) | Mixed-sign Duration → v25.x hard error |
| `google/api/servicemanagement/v1/resources.proto` | `Timestamp`, `Any`, `Struct`, `FieldMask` | Uppercase FieldMask paths rejected |
| `google/cloud/dataproc/v1/clusters.proto` | `Duration`, `FieldMask`, `Timestamp` | Both Duration and FieldMask risks |
| `google/genomics/v1/datasets.proto` | `FieldMask`, `Timestamp` | FieldMask path casing |

Full import map: 16 Timestamp importers, 10 Duration, 6 Struct, 8 Any, 6 FieldMask.

---

### 4. Contract Chain

```
protobuf v25.1 .proto definitions (binary + JSON contracts)
  └─► JSON engine (unparser.cc, parser.cc) — WKT-specific writers/parsers
        │                         │
        │ JSON/transcoding         │ binary wire (no WKT special-casing)
        ▼                         ▼
gRPC JSON transcoding       gRPC binary codec (proto_utils.h)
                                  │
                          xDS UPB layer [FROZEN SNAPSHOTS — DRIFT RISK]
                          src/core/ext/upb-gen/google/protobuf/
                                  │
                      ◄───────────┘
                          wire messages
                                  │
                                  ▼
        googleapis consumers (operations, logging, rpc, genomics, dataproc, …)
```

---

### 5. Contract Violations / Drift Points

| Severity | Issue | Root Cause | Affected Protos |
|---|---|---|---|
| **CRITICAL** | UPB header drift — gRPC v1.60.0 vendors frozen WKT UPB headers incompatible with protobuf v25.1 UPB runtime | No auto-regeneration on protobuf upgrade | xDS node metadata, all xDS resource parsing |
| **HIGH** | Duration sign-consistency now enforced | New `WriteDuration` validation at L667–669 | `google/rpc/error_details.proto` (RetryInfo), dataproc, runtimeconfig |
| **HIGH** | FieldMask uppercase path rejection | `WriteFieldMask` new strictness | genomics, dataproc, servicemanagement, appengine, storagetransfer |
| **MEDIUM** | Empty Struct Value silently discarded | Silent drop in `WriteValue`/`WriteMap` | LogEntry.struct_payload, audit_log, datastore entities |
| **MEDIUM** | Any with type_url but empty value now errors | `WriteAny` changed from silent-success | longrunning.Operation.metadata, any LRO consumer |
| **LOW** | `unquote_int64_if_possible` opt-in may break JS clients | New `PrintOptions` flag | Timestamp.seconds, Duration.seconds consumers |

---

### 6. Remediation Checklist

- **[CRITICAL]** Regenerate `src/core/ext/upb-gen/` using protobuf v25.1 `upb_generator`
- **[HIGH]** Audit all Duration producers — normalize `nanos` sign to match `seconds`
- **[HIGH]** Update FieldMask clients to strictly lowercase camelCase field paths
- **[MEDIUM]** Audit `google.longrunning.Operation.metadata` producers — populate `value` bytes when `type_url` is set
- **[MEDIUM]** Test `Struct`/`Value` pipelines end-to-end with explicit `null` entries
- Enable `allow_legacy_syntax` transitionally if immediate client changes are not feasible
- Do not enable `unquote_int64_if_possible` without confirming all consumers handle unquoted int64
